trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and ask for identity verification.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను hospital నుండి PT-1009 గారి appointment reminder కోసం call చేస్తున్నాను. దయచేసి మీ registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide pincode, volunteer context about not coming, and ask to reschedule.
steps.text: నా pincode 500032. నేను రేపు రాలేను, కొంచెం భయంగా ఉంది. దాన్ని reschedule చేయగలరా?
steps.clean_text: నా pincode 500032. నేను రేపు రాలేను, కొంచెం భయంగా ఉంది. దాన్ని reschedule చేయగలరా?
steps.model_visible_text: నా pincode 500032. నేను రేపు రాలేను, కొంచెం భారంగా ఉంది. దాన్ని reschedule చేయగలరా?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls verify_customer_identity to verify the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Verification is required before accessing or modifying the patient's appointment details.

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to confirm department and appointment status.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls lookup_patient_record to check the patient's open appointment and department.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to know the department of the existing appointment to reschedule it.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification, reassure the patient, and ask for rescheduling preferences.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent reassures the patient without giving medical advice and offers to reschedule.
steps.text: మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. మీరు cardiology department కి వెళ్ళాలి, కంగారు పడకండి. నేను మీ appointment ని reschedule చేయగలను. మీకు ఎన్ని రోజుల తర్వాత slot కావాలి?
steps.planner_rationale: The user expressed anxiety and asked to reschedule; the agent must route/reassure without clinical advice per BR_HC_01.

steps.purpose: Re-engage the silent user and offer specific options for rescheduling.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent re-engages the user after silence without restarting the workflow or repeating the prompt verbatim.
steps.text: హలో, మీరు లైన్ లో ఉన్నారా? cardiology appointment కోసం 3 days లేదా 7 days లోపు slots చెక్ చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: The user went silent mid-task; the agent prompts again with specific options to help them decide.

steps.purpose: Choose timeframe and ask clarifying questions about doctor and fee.
steps.text: ఆ... సారీ అండి. 3 days లోపు slots చూడండి. అసలు ఏ డాక్టర్ ఉంటారు, fee ఎంత అవుతుంది? నాకు అన్నీ clear గా తెలియాలి.
steps.clean_text: ఆ... సారీ అండి. 3 days లోపు slots చూడండి. అసలు ఏ డాక్టర్ ఉంటారు, fee ఎంత అవుతుంది? నాకు అన్నీ clear గా తెలియాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: ఆ... సారీ అండి. 3 days లోపు slots చూడండి. అసలు ఏ డాక్టర్ ఉంటారు, fee ఎంత అవుతుంది? నాకు అన్నీ clear గా తెలియాలి.

steps.purpose: Check available slots for cardiology within 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls check_doctor_availability for the requested timeframe.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested slots within 3 days, so the agent queries availability to offer options.

steps.purpose: Offer the available slot and quote the fee based strictly on tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the exact doctor, time, and fee returned by the tool without any unsupported guarantees.
steps.text: Thursday ఉదయం 11:00 AM కి Dr. Rao గారితో slot ఉంది. Consultation fee 600 రూపాయలు. నేను ఈ slot book చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must present the exact slot details and fee to the user for confirmation, adhering to BR_HC_02 and BR_HC_04.

steps.purpose: Restate figures to confirm understanding and agree to book.
steps.text: Thursday 11:00 AM, Dr. Rao గారితో, fee 600 రూపాయలు. సరే అండి, దయచేసి book చేయండి.
steps.clean_text: Thursday 11:00 AM, Dr. Rao గారితో, fee 600 రూపాయలు. సరే అండి, దయచేసి book చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Thursday 11:00 AM, Dr. Rao గారితో, fee 600 రూపాయలు. సరే అండి, దయచేసి book చేయండి.

steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls book_appointment to confirm the slot chosen by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: The user confirmed the slot details, so the agent proceeds to book it.

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking and provide the reference number.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent confirms the appointment using the exact details and booking reference returned by the tool.
steps.text: మీ appointment confirm అయింది. మీ booking reference B-7788. Dr. Rao గారితో Thursday 11:00 AM కి మీ consultation ఉంటుంది, fee 600 రూపాయలు. ధన్యవాదాలు.
steps.planner_rationale: The workflow concludes by providing the user with their confirmed booking reference and restating the details.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
